CustomField.label: Current Level
CustomField.description:
★R9 Which level of the approval chain the invitee is waiting on: 1 while the Account Owner has it, 2 once they have approved and it has moved up, and so on. Set to 1 by the initial submission action and advanced by each step's approval action; blank on a Draft row.
It exists because a chain took a meaning away from Pending_Count__c. With one approver, "pending" meant "waiting on one named person"; with a chain it means "somewhere in a chain", which is a less useful thing for an AM to read. This field gives the answer back to reports and to the approval screen without anyone having to open the Approval History.
Two honest limits. It is written by workflow field updates attached to approval steps, so it is only as accurate as those actions firing — verify on a real org, which this repo cannot. And it is not what decides who may act: that is the approval process's own work item, which InviteeApprovalController reads directly rather than trusting this number.
